versions.changelog:
Initial release of the labor-arbitration skill.

- Provides end-to-end guidance for labor arbitration, supporting rights protection processes for workers across China.
- Covers evidence assessment, document checklist, online submission instructions, mediation strategy advice, and automatic arbitration document generation.
- Supports personalized evidence and document preparation, with workflows tailored by region.
- Includes built-in references and calculation formulas for claims such as owed wages, unlawful termination compensation, double wage claims, and overtime pay.
- Offers region-specific legal rules and important reminders on time limits and best practices.
